issue.title: bug: invalid process.write arguments crash the session instead of failing the tool
issue.body:
### Component

CLI

### Summary

### Component

Unified harness runtime (Python) — `tools.process.write`

### Summary

An invalid `process.write` call crashes the whole session instead of returning a tool error.

`validate_process_action` raises a bare `ValueError` (via `_validate_write` → `_required_string`) when a `process.write` action has neither `text`, `control`, nor a non-empty `bytesBase64`. The intent-reservation call site (`harness/runtimes/python/python/mistralai_vibe_local_harness/vibe/_runtime.py:2073`, `_resolve_action`) only catches `ProcessActionError`, so the `ValueError` escapes to the agent loop (`_drive`) and terminates the session.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Start a session and have the model launch a background process (`tools.process.start`).
2. Have it call `tools.process.write` with arguments lacking `text`/`control` (empty/missing `bytesBase64`).
3. Observed: the session aborts with `Error: process Action bytesBase64 must be a nonempty string` (plus the generic "new Vibe TUI" banner).
4. Expected: the tool call fails with a normal tool error the model can react to; the session continues.

### Versions

- mistral-vibe 2.26.1 (commit 4ae5c59)
- File: `harness/runtimes/python/python/mistralai_vibe_local_harness/vibe/_process_actions.py`
- Linux (x86_64)

### Proposed fix

Convert the validation `ValueError` into a `ProcessActionError` with the existing `invalid_arguments` code in `validate_process_action`, so the action is refused (unchanged semantics) but surfaced as a tool failure to the model instead of killing the session. Fix pushed on a fork: `13pass/mistral-vibe`, branch `fix/process-action-invalid-args`.


### Reproduction steps

1. Start a session and have the model launch a background process (`tools.process.start`).
2. Have it call `tools.process.write` with arguments lacking `text`/`control` (empty/missing `bytesBase64`).

4. Expected: the tool call fails with a normal tool error the model can react to; the session continues.

### Versions / environment

Root cause: _validate_write/_required_string raises ValueError for empty input, but _resolve_action only catches ProcessActionError. The validation exception escapes _drive rather than being converted into an invalid_arguments tool failure.
